author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Urias traded to Blue Jays
desc: The Blue Jays have acquired utility INF Luis Urias from the Arizona Diamondbacks for cash considerations.
impact: Urias will figure to hold a depth role off the bench for Toronto.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adley Rutschman not in lineup Saturday
desc: Adley Rutschman is not in the Orioles lineup on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Rutschman is sitting for a second straight game following his early exit from Thursday's game against the Mariners.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Seigler recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Red Sox recalled Anthony Seigler from Triple-A.
impact: Seigler will hold a depth spot off the bench for Boston with Isiah Kiner-Falefa placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isiah Kiner-Falefa (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Red Sox placed Isiah Kiner-Falefa on the injured list with left forearm inflammation.
impact: Kiner-Falefa was scratched just before first pitch on Friday. Anthony Seigler was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) throws off mound to standing catcher
desc: Blake Snell threw off the mound to a standing catcher on Saturday.
impact: It is not an official bullpen, but it is a step in the right direction for Snell as he continues to work his way back from surgery.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brock Stewart (foot) could be activated on upcoming road trip
desc: Brock Stewart told reporters he could be activated from the injured list on the team's upcoming road trip.
impact: Stewart his left foot responded really good after pitching in back-to-back rehab games. He is working his way back from a foot injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Young exits early Saturday
desc: Jacob Young left Saturday's game early against the Rays.
impact: Young made a running catch and crashed into the outfield wall. He was able to walk off the field under his own power.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker hitting seventh in lineup Saturday
desc: Kyle Tucker is hitting seventh in the Dodgers lineup for Saturday's game against the Orioles.
impact: Tucker will be hitting in the lowest spot he has been in all season. Tommy Edman moves ahead of him in the lineup.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani back in lineup Saturday
desc: Shohei Ohtani is back in the Dodgers lineup on Saturday against the Orioles.
impact: Ohtani missed just one game after being placed on the paternity list. He is back at DH and hitting leadoff.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera placed on taxi squad
desc: The Diamondbacks placed Jose Cabrera on their taxi squad.
impact: Cabrera could be promoted to start on Sunday for Arizona.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mark Leiter Jr. (hip) placed on IL
desc: The Athletics placed RHP Mark Leiter Jr. on the 15-day injured list with a right hip impingement.
impact: Leiter had been holding a high-leverage role in the Athletics bullpen. He'll figure to miss at least the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Geoff Hartlieb has contract selected by Athletics
desc: The Athletics selected the contract of RHP Geoff Hartlieb from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Hartlieb will be making his season debut. He'll figure to hold a low-leverage role in the Athletics bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Romy Gonzalez dealing with hip injury on rehab assignment
desc: Romy Gonzalez is dealing with hip flexor soreness and is out of Double-A Portland's lineup for Saturday's game.
impact: Gonzalez is on a rehab assignment working his way back from shoulder surgery. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Burrows to likely return to rotation next week
desc: Mike Burrows is expected to return to the Astros rotation next week in Toronto.
impact: The Astros play in Toronto to begin next week. It is unclear which game he will start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lance McCullers Jr. (shoulder) to make rehab start next week
desc: Lance McCullers Jr. will make a rehab start next week.
impact: McCullers threw 25 pitches off the mound on Friday. He has been on the injured list since mid-May with shoulder inflammation.
